Key audit matter: Valuation of biological assets and bearer plants

As at 31 March 2022, the carrying amount of biological
assets was KShs 100 million..
As described further in note 14, the measurement of
biological assets is complex as it involves a high degree
of subjectivity due to the assumptions and judgements
used in determining the yields and market prices of coffee
berries in future using the discounted cash flows method.
Due to the judgement involved as described above, we
considered this to be a key audit matter.
How the matter was addressed in the audi:
Our audit procedures included understanding
management’s processes for measuring
biological assets and evaluating compliance
with IAS 41 Agriculture.
We assessed whether the assumptions and the
methodology applied in the determination of
the fair value of biological assets were reasonable
and adequately supported.
We also assessed the adequacy of the company’s
disclosures in respect of biological assets.
